title: Upload checksums and secure reset tokens
author: benchmark
note: Safe: SHA-256 used for file integrity (not passwords); secrets module for tokens.

changed_files.diff:
+import hashlib
+
+def file_sha256(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):
+            h.update(chunk)
+    return h.hexdigest()

+import secrets
+
+def create_reset_token(user):
+    user.reset_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
+    return user.reset_token
